paragraphs: Farmer John's cows have been holding a daily online gathering on the "mooZ" video meeting platform. For fun, they have invented a simple number game to play during the meeting to keep themselves entertained.

Elsie has three positive integers A, B, and C (A ≤ B ≤ C). These integers are supposed to be secret, so she will not directly reveal them to her sister Bessie. Instead, she gives Bessie seven (not necessarily distinct) integers in the range 1…10⁹, claiming that they are A, B, C, A + B, B + C, C + A, and A + B + C in some order.
Given a list of these seven numbers, please help Bessie determine A, B, and C. It can be shown that the answer is unique.
inputFormat: The only line of input consists of seven space-separated integers.
outputFormat: Print A, B, and C separated by spaces.

sampleExplanation.title: Sample Analysis
sampleExplanation.detail: Sorting the seven integers gives [2, 2, 4, 7, 9, 9, 11]. With A = 2, B = 2, C = 7, the pairwise sums are 4, 9, 9 and the total sum A + B + C = 11.

hints.title: Use Positivity (A, B, C ≥ 1)
hints.body: Since A, B, and C are all positive integers with A ≤ B ≤ C, what are the two smallest numbers among the seven values? And what is the single largest number?

hints.title: Sort the Seven Numbers
hints.body: Sort the 7 numbers as x₀ ≤ x₁ ≤ … ≤ x₆. Because A + B > B ≥ A, the two smallest numbers MUST be x₀ = A and x₁ = B! Can x₂ always be C? Careful: A + B could be smaller than C (like 2 + 2 = 4 < 7 in the sample!).

hints.title: Recover C from the Maximum
hints.body: The largest of the 7 numbers is always x₆ = A + B + C. Since you already know A = x₀ and B = x₁, you can immediately compute C = x₆ − x₀ − x₁!

editorial.summary: Sort the 7 positive integers in non-decreasing order. Since A, B, C > 0 and A ≤ B ≤ C, the two smallest values are guaranteed to be A = nums[0] and B = nums[1], while the largest value is A + B + C = nums[6]. Therefore C = nums[6] − nums[0] − nums[1].

solutions.python:
import sys

def solve():
    nums = sorted(map(int, sys.stdin.read().split()))
    a = nums[0]
    b = nums[1]
    c = nums[6] - a - b
    print(a, b, c)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
